note: Daze, AI-powered creative messaging app; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page).
Decent, health insurance for the self-employed; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2018 (firm's own page).
Dedrone, airspace security and drone detection; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2016 (firm's own page). Axon acquired it in 2024.

Delfi Diagnostics, blood-based early cancer detection; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2019 (firm's own page). Form D 2019-2025 to $225M, Greg Yap on the filings — the graduation leg is verified by the later rounds.
Delphi, digital minds for expertise; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page). The Wikidata pre-fill said DE, a namesake collision with Delphi the automotive supplier.

Digital Insight, online banking software; NASDAQ IPO 1999, Intuit acquired it in 2007 for $1.35B and NCR bought it on in 2013. A mid-1990s Menlo position on the 1998 internet page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

DiVitas Networks, fixed-mobile convergence software; wound down around 2011. First listed 2007, so the entry is pre-window and entry_stage is null — the band's 'Pre-Seed' rides a $425k 2010 filing three years after the entry.
DocuSign (DOCU, Nasdaq), electronic agreements; IPO 2018. A REST-only historical listing with no milestone; Menlo's entry is an early-2000s position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Drawbridge, cross-device identity for advertising; LinkedIn acquired it in 2019. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.

DriveCam, video telematics — renamed Lytx in 2013 and recapitalised by GTCR in 2016. Form D 2011-2012 to $85M with Douglas Carlisle; a growth entry. The base also carries 'lytx', the same company under its later name.
Dropcam: Menlo led the $12M Series B in June 2012 (the site dates the close 2011 — the close-year rule of decisions.md R1). Google acquired it for $555M in 2014.
Earli, early cancer detection and treatment; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).
Edge Delta, distributed observability; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page), Form D 2021-2022 with Tim Tully on the filings.
EdgeCast Networks, CDN; Verizon acquired it in 2013 for ~$400M and it later became part of Edgio. Listed from 2012 with no milestone; entry round not established.

eero, mesh home WiFi; Amazon acquired it in 2019. THE ENTRY IS THE 2014 SEED, in the firm's own words: 'We first invested in eero's seed round two years ago' (the 2016 post announcing the $50M round it led, which is the first Special Opportunities Fund deal). The Form D band read Growth off that 2016 filing.
Efficient Networks, DSL customer-premise equipment; NASDAQ IPO 1999, Siemens acquired it in 2001 for $1.5B. A mid-1990s Menlo position on the 1998 pages, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Egnyte, enterprise content collaboration and governance. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.

Eleos Health, clinical AI for behavioral health; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2023 (firm's own page). Israeli-founded with a Boston US office; HQ recorded as Israel on the company's own presentation.
Enable, B2B rebate management; Menlo led the Series A in 2020 (firm's own page and its own announcement post). British company with a San Francisco office.
Encoded Therapeutics, precision gene therapy; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2019 (firm's own page).
Endgame, product-led sales; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page). Distinct from Endgame Inc, the security company Elastic bought in 2019.
EndoVascular Technologies, endovascular aortic grafts (Ancure); Guidant acquired it in 1997. A late-1980s Menlo position on the 1998 medical page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Entone, IPTV set-top and home media; Amino Technologies acquired it in 2015. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Envoy, workplace visitor and desk management; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2018 (firm's own page).
ePAC (ePac Technologies), on-demand book printing; first listed 2004, so the entry is pre-window and entry_stage is null — the band's 'Seed' rides a 2010 $6M filing six years later.
Epic!, digital reading for children; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2014 (firm's own page). BYJU'S acquired it in 2021 for $500M and it was sold on in 2024 after BYJU'S collapse.
Epiodyne, non-addictive opioid analgesics; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2018 (firm's own page).

Eppo, warehouse-native experimentation; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2022 (firm's own page). Datadog acquired it in 2025. The Form D band read Growth off the 2024 $31.8M filing, two years after the entry.

Eve, the plaintiff-side legal AI platform (founded 2020); Menlo partnered at the seed in 2022 (firm's own page). The row wrongly carries a 2000 wayback year from eve.com, the 1999 beauty e-tailer on the Prior Investments list, and the public/GB/$353M pre-fill belongs to Eve Sleep plc, a third company — both disputed and flagged for the identity file.
Everlaw, litigation and ediscovery platform; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2018 (firm's own page). The Form D band read Series A. Last primary $2.0B (2021 Series D).
eXelate, audience data for advertising; Nielsen acquired it in 2015 for ~$200M. Form D 2012 $12.0M with Mark Siegel.
F5 (FFIV, Nasdaq), application delivery and security; IPO 1999. Menlo's entry is a 1996-97 position on the firm's 1998 pages, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Fab.com, design e-commerce; collapsed from a $1B mark and its assets were sold to PCH in 2015. Form D 2011-2012 to $100.8M with Pravin Vazirani.

FaxSav, internet fax; merged into Mail.com in 1999. A 1990s Menlo position recovered from the LOGO-ONLY row on the 1998 internet page (companies/faxsav.gif) and corroborated by a fund 13G. Pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Fieldwire, construction field management; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2019 (firm's own page). Hilti acquired it in 2021 for $300M.
Finch, unified payroll and HR API; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2020 (firm's own page). Its own 2023 post calls the Series B its third investment in three years.
FireHydrant, incident response; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2020 (firm's own page). Freshworks acquired it in 2025.
FiveStars, small-business loyalty and payments; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2014 (firm's own page). SumUp acquired it in 2021 for ~$317M.
Fleetsmith, Apple device management; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2019 (firm's own page). Apple acquired it in 2020. The Form D band read Series A off the same year's filing.

FlexiInternational Software, financial accounting applications; NASDAQ IPO 1997, taken private and later sold. A 1990s Menlo position (the 1998 software page's logo-only 'flexi' row), pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Flurry, mobile app analytics; Yahoo acquired it in 2014 for ~$200-300M. Form D 2010-2014 with Sonja Perkins on the filings.
Fox Robotics, autonomous forklifts; Form D 2022 $19.8M with Mark Siegel. On the job board but not on the portfolio listing — a live position the CMS has not published.
Frame Technology (FrameMaker); Adobe acquired it in 1995 for ~$500M. A late-1980s Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Freightquote.com, freight brokerage; C.H. Robinson acquired it in 2015 for $365M. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Function Health, membership lab testing; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2025 (firm's own page). Last primary $2.5B (2025).
